Class ExitZone

java.lang.Object
pws.editor.semantics.ExitZone
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ExitZone extends Object implements Serializable
An ExitZone represents one autonomous‐transition “exit” from a PWSState’s reactive semantics.

Each ExitZone records:

  • stateMachineId: the ID of the component state machine where the autonomous transition occurs;
  • transition: the specific autonomous transition object;
  • source: a BasicStateProposition naming the machine and source state, indicating the condition under which the autonomous transition fires;
  • target: a BasicStateProposition naming the machine and target state, indicating the outcome state and thus the “deviation” from the PWSState’s own semantics.

In computing reactive transitions, we match an ExitZone’s target proposition against the guard proposition of a PWSTransition. Whenever they coincide, we apply an internal transformation of the PWSState’s reactive semantics by invoking stateSemantics.transformByMachineTransition(...) with the zone’s machineId and transition. Multiple matching zones are OR‑ed together to yield the transition’s contribution to the target state’s overall semantics.
